title: Luxury Room w/ self check-in, 15 min from downtown
description:
Unwind in this stylish private bedroom in a peaceful shared 4-bedroom home. The room features cozy furnishings, a bedside lamp, nightstand, walk-in closet, and 6-drawer dresser for ample storage. Enjoy shared bathrooms, in-unit washer/dryer, high-speed Wi-Fi, a fully equipped kitchen, and a modern living area with a 75” Smart TV. Perfect for work trips, students, or extended stays seeking comfort and convenience.

The space
The bedroom is tastefully furnished with a Queen-size bed, bedside lamp and nightstand, spacious walk-in closet with an additional 6-drawer dresser to accommodate all your wardrobe needs. There is an in-unit laundry room with washer and dryer for your use. Keep in mind this will be a shared living space so please be respectful of the other guests in the home.
The living area boasts of modern decor and two living rooms with furniture and 75 smart TV . The home also includes a patio space to enjoy the evening breeze and an ideal spot for relaxation. It also comes with a fully equipped kitchen and Wi-Fi access. There are three parking spots in the driveway and garage + street parking available

Guest access
Please keep in mind that you will be staying in a private bedroom with shared bathrooms, living rooms, kitchen, dining area & backyard. During your stay, there will be other guests in the house as well. We ask everyone to be courteous and respectful of each other and please be mindful of loud noises.

During your stay
Don't hesistate to reach out if you need travel advice, local restaturant and bar recommendation, or any question or concern about anything, we'll be happy to help!

We hope your Airbnb experience will be 5-star worthy! Let us know if there's any way we can help make your stay even better in Nashville!
